blocks.en: We now address the question whether a function in $H^k(\Omega)$ can be extended to a function in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$. We first note a trivial extension result.
blocks.zh: 现在讨论能否将 $H^k(\Omega)$ 中的函数延拓为 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中的函数. 先指出一个显然的延拓结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$. Then $u$ can be extended to a function in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ by defining it to be zero outside $\overline\Omega$, i.e., we set $(u,\phi)=\int_{\Omega}\overline{u(\bm{x})}\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$ for every $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^m)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$. 那么通过在 $\overline\Omega$ 外定义为零, 可将 $u$ 延拓为 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中的函数, 即对每个 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 令 $(u,\phi)=\int_{\Omega}\overline{u(\bm{x})}\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$.
blocks.label: lem:zero-boundary-sobolev-zero-extension

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Take a sequence $u_n\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ which converges to $u$ in $H^k(\Omega)$. Then $u_n$ also converges in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$.
blocks.zh: 取在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 中收敛到 $u$ 的序列 $u_n\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$. 那么 $u_n$ 也在 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中收敛.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We next consider the case of a half-space. Let $\mathbb{R}_+^m=\{x_m>0\}$. We have the following result.
blocks.zh: 接着考察半空间的情形. 令 $\mathbb{R}_+^m=\{x_m>0\}$. 有以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $k\geq0$ be an integer. Then there exists a bounded linear mapping $E:H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)\to H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ with the property that $(Eu)|_{\mathbb{R}_+^m}=u$ for every $u\in H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$. Moreover, for any given $K\in\mathbb{N}$, $E$ can be chosen independently of $k$ for $0\leq k\leq K$.
blocks.zh: 设 $k\geq0$ 为整数. 那么存在有界线性映射 $E:H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)\to H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 使对每个 $u\in H^k(\mathbb{R}_+^m)$ 有 $(Eu)|_{\mathbb{R}_+^m}=u$. 此外, 对任意给定的 $K\in\mathbb{N}$, 可对 $0\leq k\leq K$ 选取与 $k$ 无关的 $E$.
blocks.label: thm:halfspace-sobolev-bounded-extension
